# International

In addition to our English-language coverage on SPIEGEL International, we also offer an expanded selection on Substack. With "SPIEGEL – The German View," you’ll get even more articles and original reporting from a European perspective, delivered several times a week, with earlier access on Substack – in the app or delivered straight to your inbox as a newsletter. Interested? Give it a try and [subscribe for free](https://derspiegel.substack.com/subscribe).
